findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: No CFPM was present during the inspection. 
(A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: Provide a self-closer for the door or signage that indicates the door should be closed between uses. 
(A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. 

Upon arrival, inspector observed buckets of water within the basins of the handwashing sink, and each basin of the triple sink. PIC stated she does not have running water and that the buckets would suffice for handwashing and warewashing purposes. Inspector advised this is not sufficient as it is a requirement for mobile units to have water available. Water supply is apparently run by a generator that is not present at the location of the unit. Phone call placed to food program supervisor and PIC was asked to cease operations at this time until running water is available at unit.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

PIC is not a CFM. Only ceritifcation available is a food handler's card for a person who was not present at time of inspection. Discussed requirements with PIC. Correct by next routine.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

Observed no CFPM available during inspection. Provided paperwork for certification training. Discussed with PIC that a CFPM must be present during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements. Discussed with PIC. Provided paperwork. Inspector will follow-up on 9/25/20.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed no Norovirus illness clean-up policy. Discussed policy with PIC. Provided new copy. Discussed placing policy and employee health reporting agreements in binder/folder on truck. Inspector will follow-up on 9/25/20. Facility has bleach to perform procedure.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

Observed hand sink to be inoperable. No water was available. PIC called friend to bring replacement part. Inspector did not observe any food preparation during inspection. Facility temporarily/voluntarily closed until hand sink is rectified. Discussed temporary handwashing station set-up as an option. Inspector will follow-up at end of business day.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

Observed sani bucket to be too low - 0 ppm. Discussed frequent changes with PIC. PIC re-made sani bucket - 200 ppm quat. COS.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.comment:
5-103.11: The water source and system shall be of sufficient capacity to meet the peak water demands (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands.

Observed no hot water at hand sink. PIC was having part fixed. Temporary handwashing station discussed. No water at handsink. Inspector will follow-up this afternoon by close of business.
